summary: Diff adds a new Motoko actor with template metadata + user profile APIs (with admin/user permissions), and a new React app shell using TanStack Router with a persistent bottom tab bar, theme provider/toggle, offline banner, major update prompt UI, and basic entitlements (Free/Pro) gating helpers. Several core BuildRequest items (remote config backend, offline storage implementation evidence, full template catalog/editing, editors, docs, and generated assets) are not evidenced in the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create a cohesive “CapCut-inspired” editing UI/UX theme with documented guidelines and consistent styling/motion across key screens; avoid blue/purple as primary accent.
missing_requirements.reason: Theme toggle/provider exists, but the diff summary does not show any documented design theme guidelines (typography/spacing/motion) or a defined non-blue/purple primary palette applied across key screens/editors.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement an offline-first local data layer for projects, imported media metadata, and downloaded templates with caching and graceful offline handling.
missing_requirements.reason: An offline banner/hook exists, and code references storage modules (projectsStore/templatesCache), but the diff summary does not include the actual storage layer implementation (IndexedDB/localStorage persistence, media metadata persistence, template download/cache behavior).

missing_requirements.requirement: Templates section with preloaded editable template catalog entries (specified Video and Photo lists), editable layers/fields, save as new project, downloadable and cached for offline use; backend provides canonical template catalog endpoint/config.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend exposes template metadata queries, and frontend merges a PRELOADED_TEMPLATES list, but the diff summary does not show the required specific template entries, grouping by Video/Photo UI, any template payload download mechanism, or editor instantiation with editable layers/fields beyond creating a project metadata stub.

missing_requirements.requirement: Offline-capable video editor with timeline multi-layer composition and operations (trim, split, crop, transitions, text animations, music selection, speed control, filters/color adjustments, pinch-to-zoom timeline, export 720p/1080p no watermark).
missing_requirements.reason: Routes reference a VideoEditorScreen, but the diff summary provides no evidence of timeline UI, layer system, editing operations, touch pinch-to-zoom, or export implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Offline-capable photo editor supporting crop/resize, filters/presets, brightness/contrast/saturation, text/stickers, background blur, basic background removal, export JPG/PNG.
missing_requirements.reason: Routes reference a PhotoEditorScreen, but the diff summary provides no evidence of photo editing tools, persistence of adjustments, background blur/removal, or export implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Dynamic update architecture via remotely configurable JSON (feature toggles/tools/templates/remote template repo), version check on launch, silent background refresh, and major version update prompt; backend exposes versioned remote config JSON.
missing_requirements.reason: A MajorUpdatePrompt UI exists and a useRemoteConfig hook is referenced, but the diff summary does not show backend remote-config/version APIs, the remote-config hook/types implementation, startup fetch/caching, background refresh logic, or template repo download+cache behavior driven by config.

missing_requirements.requirement: Projects management: list, search/sort, duplicate, delete, open projects; stored locally and works offline.
missing_requirements.reason: Hooks for list/search/delete/duplicate are added, but the diff summary does not show the Projects screen UI, sort behavior, open-routing behavior, or the underlying local persistence implementation in storage/projectsStore.

missing_requirements.requirement: Feature-gating system Free vs Pro with single source of truth, premium marking + explanatory prompt, and a config toggle to disable monetization/gating UI entirely.
missing_requirements.reason: Entitlements helpers and upsell UI exist, and monetization toggle is read from RemoteConfig, but the diff summary does not show templates/tools being marked as premium, enforcement preventing use on Free with explanatory prompt, or the actual remote config implementation providing the toggle.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend Motoko APIs for (a) remote config/versioning, (b) template catalog metadata, (c) optional user-scoped cloud sync scaffolding toggleable by config (II auth if enabled).
missing_requirements.reason: Backend provides template metadata APIs and user profile storage, but no remote config/versioning API is present, and no user-scoped project CRUD/sync scaffolding is evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add in-repo architecture documentation covering folder structure, state management, offline storage, editor engine approach, and dynamic update system flow.
missing_requirements.reason: No documentation file is shown in the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Generate and include required static brand/UI assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them from the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: No generated asset files or UI references to frontend/public/assets/generated are shown in the diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/user permissioned access-control system with secret-token initialization and admin-only template mutation APIs.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask for an admin token flow or access-control initialization via a URL secret parameter; it only required remote config/template catalog APIs and optional cloud sync scaffolding.

hallucinated_features.description: Mandatory authenticated user profile onboarding gate that forces setting a display name before using the app.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not require a name/profile setup modal gate; it only mentioned II auth if needed for cloud sync and Pro entitlements gating.
